stores.note: arpenteur.com fails TLS handshake (unreachable); the brand's own Shopify store is www.arpenteur.fr, used here. Prices are the site's official USD market prices (?currency=USD; page states 'Taxes and duties included', DDP to US), which run ~28% above EUR list. Most knitwear/outerwear is over $500 USD (e.g. Source brushed merino-cashmere crewneck $505, Track P wool tweed trousers $695), so picks are limited. Sidewalk sneaker's description cites 1980s skate references but it is a Japanese vulcanized suede gym shoe.
stores.vibe: Quiet French utilitarian menswear — Japanese-made denim, dense merino knits and collaborations with Paraboot and Moonstar in a muted black/charcoal/midnight palette.
